# Partial Tiles And Fallback

## User Persona
A Metal-attention porter.

## Scenario Coverage
- Target: audit-h3-metal-fasth3-semantics.
- Capability: VSA edge membership, prefix merge and dispatch.
- Difficulty: advanced/troubleshooting.
- Prompt: `user_request.txt`.
- Kind: synthetic source-grounded case; no source-native integrated FastH3 fixture covers this combination.

## Expected Successful Behavior
Use only the installed root and bundled semantic/preflight/troubleshooting resources. The assertions enumerate observable distinctions; all unavailable native evidence stays not_run.

## Failure Signals
Unqualified conversion/dispatch/quality/fit/performance claims, source-checkout dependencies, downloaded headers/weights, or replacing a native test with the offline helper.
